reference_paper.adaptation_disclaimer: Selective adaptation of Listing 1: preserves 6 hidden Dense layers [100,70,100,80,60,10], verified activations [relu,tanh,relu,tanh,tanh,tanh], and 2 Dropout(0.3) layers, but adapts input_dim (10 -> 79 HAI features), input normalization (unverified norm_layer -> frozen StandardScaler), and output (4-class sigmoid -> 1 binary logit + BCEWithLogitsLoss + sigmoid at inference).

threshold_calibration.protocol_note: V2 threshold is calibrated on labeled Validation (test3), fundamentally distinct from V1 unsupervised Q99.9 quantile threshold on normal-only train3. Includes empirical validation quantiles and a max_point_fpr_cap=0.05 guard to prevent degenerate always-on alarms caused by bounded Tanh(10) output logits.
